items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: And then when I got with him he was doing the Charlie Brown stuff. And in fact I did one of those, I did a TV — I think it’s called “The Charlie Brown Valentine Special” or something like that. We did that.

ctx.x: Yeah. “Cast Your Fate” I think happened in the early 60s, like maybe ’61 or ’62 or 3, right in there. And I wasn’t here yet. So yeah, he was already on the map. He was a favorite around here. And then when I got with him he was doing the Charlie Brown stuff. And in fact I did one of those, I did a TV — I think it’s called “The Charlie Brown Valentine Special” or something like that. We did that.
So if you were to watch that on TV you’d be listening to yourself?
